task_objective: Implement the fuzzy SQL IntelliSense plan on feat/fuzzy-sql-intellisense.
design_decisions: The implementation starts from dev after the supplied plan is committed as the first feature-branch commit.
Project tooling runs through ./run.sh and writes environments and caches under /tmp/wherewolf.
Spark execution and metadata obtain separate child sessions from one lock-protected root context; neither request cleanup nor metadata discovery stops that root.
The engine selector changes future completion contexts for every open and new editor, while one Qt worker publishes cached Spark metadata without reopening an active completion list.
